description: This file defines the 'Action' class for Drupal, representing a configurable action entity with plugin management and execution capabilities.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents a configurable action entity with plugin management, including creation, execution, and sorting.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Action entity, defaulting label from plugin definition if not provided.

methods.name: getPluginCollection
methods.description: Returns the plugin collection associated with this action, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns an array of plugin collections, currently only 'configuration'.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves the plugin instance associated with this action.

methods.name: setPlugin
methods.description: Sets the plugin ID for this action and updates the plugin collection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the plugin's action on multiple entities.

methods.name: isConfigurable
methods.description: Checks if the plugin implements ConfigurableInterface.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the action.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Static method to sort two Action entities based on their type.
